title: Virtual Compute: resumption
content:
## Formal basis

Virtual Compute — The contract status is suspended. The contract payment restriction status is clear. Restore a suspended holding after its official payment restriction clears; no customer promise substitutes for recorded clearance. Set status active. Bill resumption fee under the lifecycle fee basis only when positive, and preserve retained-resource history. A contract already active needs no write; a closed contract requires a new signed application and cannot be resumed.

## Evidence — contract state

For resume, The contract status is suspended. Before this action, authoritative system records establish the condition using compute contract reference, status. Those records correlate to the current action by compute contract reference.

## Evidence — restriction cleared

For resume, The contract payment restriction status is clear. Before this action, authoritative system records establish the condition using compute contract reference, payment restriction status. Those records correlate to the current action by compute contract reference.

## Contract transition

The agent performs the suspended to active contract transition using the authoritative evidence required for that action.
